Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Csaba Pálinkás lived longer by comparing only death years (2004 vs. 1977) and ignoring the different birth years. This flawed heuristic (“the one who died later necessarily lived longer”) led to a wrong conclusion; proper comparison of lifespans (≈45 years vs. ≈70 years) shows Henry Scheffé lived longer.
